component.name: GalleryBrowser
component.summary: Linux-native asset browser for video, images and sequences

description.p: GalleryBrowser is a Linux-native asset browser for video first, plus images and numbered image sequences. It is written in Rust on the egui and wgpu stack, with pure-Rust media decoding (no FFmpeg or GStreamer needed), and plays MOV, MP4, MXF, MKV and AVI files in ProRes, DNxHD/DNxHR, H.264, HEVC and AV1.

ul.li: Browse and preview video, images and image sequences in a dark, fast interface
Frame-accurate scrubbing, frame stepping and audio playback for video
EXR and other numbered image sequence playback
Copy, move, rename and trash with a background worker that never overwrites
Batch rename with chainable operations and live preview
Favorites, recent folders, tags, collections and ratings

description.p: Fix single-instance file forwarding on macOS and case-only renames on case-insensitive filesystems.
Rewritten in Rust on the ArtCraft stack (egui, wgpu, pure-Rust media) with video-first browsing and playback.
Initialize the Ctrl-hover scrub pipeline and render decoded frames on the GUI thread.
Restore the original file-drag payload and prevent hidden processes from blocking relaunch.
Initial release with core gallery browsing, preview, and file management features.
